observations.body: The king orders one people and foreign worship, builds an abomination on the altar, burns incense, suppresses Scripture, and executes those who resist.
observations.label: Imperial sacrifice desecrates the altar

observations.body: The passage presents imperial decree, forbidden offerings, altar abomination, burned books, circumcision ban, and costly resistance as the scene's observable response or movement.

payload.posture: Read 1 Maccabees 1:41–64 as evidence about sacrifice, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: the passage shows imposed sacrifice as covenant violation rather than neutral cultural exchange
